history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with curly black hair, wearing white earbuds and glasses, stands with his back to the viewer, operating a DJ setup. He's dressed in a light brown jacket over a white collared shirt, black shorts that reach his knees, white crew socks, and black dress shoes. A large black duffel bag hangs from his right shoulder.

The setting appears to be a modern, somewhat industrial-chic space, possibly a cafe or a lounge. To his left, two vintage CRT televisions are stacked, the top one displaying a colorful, abstract graphic. The DJ equipment is on a wooden console. Behind the DJ, a large, two-tiered white speaker system is prominent. To the right of the speaker, a wooden bar is visible, stocked with bottles of alcohol and glasses. The background features a dark, elevated railing and some wall-mounted speakers. The lighting is soft and diffused, with warm spotlights illuminating the space, creating a slightly moody, intimate atmosphere. The color palette is a mix of muted tones – browns, blacks, whites, and grays – with pops of color from the vintage TV screen and the bottles on the bar. The overall mood is relaxed and cool, with a hint of retro aesthetic due to the vintage electronics.
